description: Source code for the WorkerMain class in Playwright's test runner, managing test execution, hooks, fixtures, and worker lifecycle.

classes.name: WorkerMain
classes.description: Main class for managing worker process in Playwright test runner, handling test execution, hooks, fixtures, and cleanup.

methods.name: _stop
methods.description: Stops the worker process, ensuring current test is interrupted.

methods.name: gracefullyClose
methods.description: Performs cleanup and shutdown of the worker, closing browsers and fixtures.

methods.name: unhandledError
methods.description: Handles unhandled errors, marking tests as failed and stopping worker if needed.

methods.name: _loadIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads configuration and project data if not already loaded.

methods.name: runTestGroup
methods.description: Runs a group of tests based on provided payload, managing test execution flow.

methods.name: customMessage
methods.description: Handles custom IPC messages related to the current test.

methods.name: _runTest
methods.description: Executes an individual test, managing hooks, fixtures, and cleanup.

methods.name: _collectHooksAndModifiers
methods.description: Collects hooks and modifiers for a suite based on type.

methods.name: _runBeforeAllHooksForSuite
methods.description: Runs all beforeAll hooks for a suite.

methods.name: _runAllHooksForSuite
methods.description: Runs all hooks (beforeAll or afterAll) for a suite.

methods.name: _runAfterAllHooksForSuite
methods.description: Runs all afterAll hooks for a suite.

methods.name: _runEachHooksForSuites
methods.description: Runs beforeEach or afterEach hooks for multiple suites.
